verdict.rationale: The docs point to runtime model management. Models can be installed from the built-in gallery on the web UI's Discover page, the web interface manages installations, and a /models/apply API endpoint exists (preloading uses its parameters). Model aliasing is also supported. However, no evidence explicitly states that multiple models can be loaded at once or switched per request without a server restart. Missing for 10: explicit docs on hot-loading/unloading models without restart, documentation of concurrent multi-model serving and per-request switching, hands-on or independent corroboration.
